mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede economic slowdowns and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS above their 90th percentiles fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation environments (CPIAUCSL > 240.0), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations face higher discount rates.
failure_condition: In high inflation environments (CPIAUCSL > 240.0), S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing and services sectors, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth above 0.5% monthly fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate exceeding 2.0% signals robust economic expansion, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profits rise.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 quarterly growth exceeds 2.0%, S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS growth > 0.3% and UNRATE decline > 0.1pp fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1200.0 thousand units signals strong residential construction activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the sector's momentum feeds into broader market sentiment.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 1200.0, S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
